sn55.54:1.1: Ekam samayam Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme || || 2.
sn55.54:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū Bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
sn55.54:1.3: Niṭṭhitacīvaro Bhagavā temāsaccayena cārikam pakkamissatī ti || || 3.
sn55.54:1.5: Sambahulā kira bhikkhū Bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
sn55.54:1.6: Niṭṭhitacīvaro Bhagavā temāsaccayena cārikam pakkamissatī ti || ||
sn55.54:1.7: Atha kho Mahānāmo sakko yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Mahānāmo sakko Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 4.
sn55.54:1.9: Sambahulā kira bhikkhū Bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
sn55.54:1.10: Niṭṭhitacīvaro Bhagavā temāsaccayena cārikam pakkamissatī ti ||
sn55.54:1.11: Na kho te etam bhante Bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
sn55.54:1.12: sappaññena upāsakena sappañño upāsako ābādhīko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno ovaditabbo ti || || 5.
sn55.54:2.1: Sappaññena Mahānama upāsakena sappañño upāsako ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno catuhi assāsaniyehi dhammehi assāsetabbo || ||
sn55.54:2.3: atthāyasmato Buddhe aveccappasādena || Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā ti || ||
sn55.54:2.7: Ariyakantāni sīlāni akhaṇḍāni || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikānī ti || || 6.
sn55.54:3.1: Sappaññena Mahānāma upāsakena sappañño upāsako ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno imehi catuhi assāsaniyehi dhammehi assāsetvā evam assa vacanīyo || || 7.
sn55.54:3.4: Atthi me mātāpitusu apekhā ti so evam assa vacanīyo ||
sn55.54:3.6: sace pāyasmā mātāpitusu apekhaṃ karissati marissateva ||
sn55.54:3.7: no ce pāyasmā mātāpitusu apekhaṃ karissati marissateva ||
sn55.54:3.8: sādhāyasmā yā te mātāpitusu apekhā tam pajahāti || || 8.
sn55.54:4.2: Yā me mātāpitusu apekhā sā pahīnā ti || so evam assa vacanīyo ||
sn55.54:4.5: Atthi me puttadāresu apekhā ti || so evam assa vacanīyo ||
sn55.54:4.7: sace pāyasmā puttadāresu apekham karissati marissateva ||
sn55.54:4.8: no ce pāyasmā puttadāresu apekhaṃ karissati marissateva ||
sn55.54:4.9: sādhāyasmā yā te puttadāresu apekhā tam pajahā ti || || 9.
sn55.54:5.2: Yā me puttadāresu apekhā sā pahīnā ti || so evam assa vacanīyo ||
sn55.54:5.3: Atthi panāyasmato mānussakesu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu apekhā ti || ||
sn55.54:5.5: Atthi me mānussakesu pañcasu kāmagunesu apekhā ti || so evam assa vacanīyo ||
sn55.54:5.6: Mānussakehi kho āvuso kāmehi dibbā kāmā abhikkantatarā ca paṇitatarā ca ||
sn55.54:5.7: sādhāyasmā mānussakehi kāmehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā catummahārājikesu devesu cittam adhimocehī ti || || 10.
sn55.54:6.2: Mānussakehi kāmehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ cātummahārājikesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocitanti || so evam assa vacanīyo ||
sn55.54:6.3: Cātummahārājikehi kho āvuso devehi Tāvatiṃsā devā abhikkantatarā ca paṇitatarā ca ||
sn55.54:6.4: sādhāyasmā cātummahārājikehi cātummahārājikehi devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā Tāvatiṃsesu devesu cittam adhimocehī ti || || 11--16.
sn55.54:7.2: Cātummahārājikehi me devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ Tāvatiṃsesu devesu cittam adhimocitan ti || so evam assa vacanīyo ||
sn55.54:7.3: Tāvatiṃsehi kho avuso devehi pi Yāmā devā
sn55.54:7.7: kho āvuso devehi Brahmaloko abhikkantataro ca paṇitataro ca ||
sn55.54:7.8: sādhāyasmā Parinimittavasavattīhi devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā Brahmaloke cittam adhimocehī ti || || 18.
sn55.54:7.10: Paranimmitavasavattīhi me devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhitam Brahmaloke cittam adhimocitan ti || so evam assa vacanīyo ||
sn55.54:7.11: Brahmaloko pi kho āvuso anicco adhuvo sakkāya pariyāpanno ||
sn55.54:7.12: sādhāyasmā Brahmalokā cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā sakkāya nirodhe cittam upasaṃharāhī ti || || 19.
sn55.54:8.2: Brahmalokā me cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ sakkāya nirodhe cittam upasaṃharāmīti ||
sn55.54:8.3: evaṃ vuttassa kho Mahānāma upāsakassa āsavā vimuttacittena bhikkhunā na kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ vadāmi yad idam
